message.text: This pointer might have type [signed int](1) (size 4), but this pointer arithmetic is done with type short * (size 2).

upstream.fix_version: No fix version established; this review does not recommend an unverified library update.

linked_profile.sanitizer_evidence: Existing T7.16 lean ASan/UBSan build compiles actual FAAC and links libfaac_lib.a; not a system-library fallback. No new build/run performed by this review.

call_trace: faac_adapter_encode forwards const void* and total sample count
faac_encoder_encode validates null/capacity/sample count then casts through historical int32_t*
faacEncEncode invokes appendInputFifo only with nonnull positive input
appendInputFifo selects INPUT_16BIT and scales by short elements plus validated channel map

diagnostic_analysis.reported_type_mismatch: The formal inputBuffer type is int32_t*, but selected PCM storage is int16_t. The pinned public API documentation and wrapper comment explicitly establish the format-dependent byte layout.
diagnostic_analysis.inference: Scaling the selected 16-bit path by two-byte samples matches the documented input contract. Replacing it with int32_t scaling would change interleaved channel selection and could overrun a correctly sized 16-bit buffer. This supports intentional reinterpretation; it is not an approved false-positive disposition.
diagnostic_analysis.valid_read_bound: For N supplied samples in whole channel groups, C channels, and map m in [0,C-1], read indices are i*C+m with 0<=i<N/C. Last read N-C+m<=N-1. Public parameter validation rejects channel-map entries outside that range.
diagnostic_analysis.separate_pointer_formation_concern: Each loop iteration also performs src += C, including after its last read. For m>0 this forms base+(N+m), beyond the one-past base+N pointer. There is no subsequent dereference in that iteration, but this prevents a blanket pointer-arithmetic safety conclusion. ASan/UBSan passing memory-access tests alone does not prove the pointer formation conforms.
diagnostic_analysis.other_limits: The historical int32_t* intermediate also deserves alignment review against the documented int16_t alignment contract. Current buffers generally satisfy stronger allocation alignment; tests should include an int16-aligned offset. Out-of-contract short allocations cannot be detected from a bare pointer/sample count; do not label them supported. Nonwhole channel groups are outside the documented caller contract.

existing_behavior_evidence.observed: Six targets / 36 Unity cases pass; real mono/stereo/eight-channel configuration and PCM/AAC media recovery controls exist. test_faac_encoder source covers mono encode/flush and HE configuration, but that target was not selected in this T7.16 run.
existing_behavior_evidence.reuse_scope: Context for actual static linkage and available valid media paths only. These tests do not isolate CODEQL-330, distinct multichannel sample selection, map bounds or final pointer formation. No exact-finding regression claimed.

proposed_child.title: Verify pinned FAAC 16-bit input scaling and public API boundaries
proposed_child.description: Tests-only producer using actual pinned faac_lib and existing layer3 registration. No source/submodule edits, mocks or system FAAC substitution.
cases: Distinct signed packed int16 samples for mono, stereo and eight channels; complete encode/flush output equals equivalent int32 samples multiplied by256 under otherwise identical configuration.
Identity and reversed valid maps plus negative/out-of-range and too-short map rejection.
Exact-sized one-channel-group, partial-frame and full-frame buffers with sanitizer redzones; int16-aligned offset storage; inputs unchanged.
NULL input with positive samples rejected; NULL/zero input flush bounded until zero output; no bogus success mutation for rejected input.
One complete channel group above declared frame sample maximum rejected; undersized and NULL output rejected; handles/allocated buffers always cleaned up and close nulls handle.
proposed_child.acceptance: Record unchanged-source results honestly, including initially passing intent controls. No forced failing expectation, unapproved exception or claim that sanitizers prove absence of pointer-formation UB. Any demonstrated defect needs a separately materialized bounded tracked upstream integration child before editing the library.
proposed_child.gate_changes: T7.24 and T33 must depend on this producer if materialized; still require separately resolved pointer-formation/alignment concerns and a verified correction or explicit authorized narrow disposition before closing CODEQL-330.
proposed_child.lease: Exclusive native/source build lease required; no runtime/server required.
